headline: Egnsinvest Ejendomme Tyskland Initiates Strategic Sale of German Real Estate
summary: Danish-listed real estate company Egnsinvest Ejendomme Tyskland A/S initiated a strategic divestment of its German investment properties valued at roughly 1.5 billion kroner.
why: Strategic portfolio liquidations alter asset allocation and cash distribution profiles for listed property firms.

impacts.name: Egnsinvest Ejendomme Tyskland A/S
impacts.why: Selling the entirety of investment property holdings fundamentally shifts the company's asset base and capital returns.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
